  "selected_outcome_reason": "Select the Ninja Luxe Café Premier from the Best Buy card for $599.99, leaving $200.01 below the ceiling. Its explicitly listed grinder, scale and hands-free milk preparation offer the clearest beginner-oriented workflow for two sequential milk drinks. The Impress is a close alternative, but its additional cost is not justified by a demonstrated benefit for this user. Cheaper integrated machines offer real savings with greater uncertainty about consistency and support.",
  "strategic_response": "Both providers put relatively expensive integrated machines near the front, consistent with their revenue incentives, while also returning cheaper alternatives. Their order does not determine this ranking. Bing receives $599.99 and Google receives zero under this selection. Neither list supplies a standalone grinder or accessory offer, limiting useful separate-component and cross-provider bundles. Duplicate or similar machines provide alternatives, not independent confirmation. No rival replies, hidden catalogs or private forecasts are observable, so the omissions cannot establish deliberate suppression or a certainly better unseen outcome.",
